hook: A legal battle over a medical drama could cost Warner Bros. Television millions.

sections.voiceover: A legal battle over a medical drama could cost Warner Bros. Television millions.

text_overlay.text: Legal battle costs Warner Bros. Television

sections.voiceover: On Wednesday, California's 2nd District Court of Appeal ruled against Warner Bros. Television in a lawsuit from Sherri Crichton. Why did the court allow this case to move forward?

text_overlay.text: Court rules against Warner Bros. Television

sections.voiceover: Except the show at the center of this dispute, The Pitt, features ER star Noah Wyle.
The unanimous three-judge panel denied the appeal from Warner Bros. Television. Sherri Crichton claims the new show infringes on her late husband's work.
The case now heads to trial, leaving the outcome unresolved.
